conversation.text: FINAL NOTICE: Your business has an outstanding penalty of GHS 4,500 for late VAT returns for the previous quarter.
Failure to settle this amount within 48 hours will result in a court summons and immediate locking of your shop premises.
Click the Ghana.gov secure payment portal link to resolve this: https://gra-gh-gov.tax-portal-login.com

choices.text: Click the link and pay the fine to avoid shop closure
Visit the official GRA portal directly or go to their nearest office

lesson.technique: Authority intimidation and fake government domain
warningSigns: The domain 'gra-gh-gov.tax-portal-login.com' is fake; real government sites end in '.gov.gh'
Scammers use aggressive threats (shop locking, court summons) to force immediate action
Official GRA emails usually address you by your registered TIN/Company Name, not generic greetings

conversation.text: Dear Contributor, your annual SSNIT pension statement is ready for review.
We noticed a discrepancy in your Tier-1 contributions from your current employer, which may affect your future payout.
Please download the attached encrypted document (SSNIT_Statement_2023.pdf.exe) and log in with your email password to review the missing funds.

choices.text: Download the attachment and enter your password to check your funds
Do not download the file and log into the SSNIT app directly

lesson.technique: Malicious attachment disguised as pension document
warningSigns: The attachment ends in '.exe', which is a dangerous executable file, not a real PDF
Legitimate PDFs do not ask you to input your email password to open them
Scammers exploit fears about missing pension funds to make you act carelessly

conversation.text: Congratulations! Based on your LinkedIn profile, you have been selected for the GNPC Graduate Trainee Program. Starting Salary: GHS 8,500/month.
Your induction is scheduled for Monday at the Accra Head Office. Attached is your official offer letter.
To process your staff ID and mandatory background check, please pay the GHS 450 processing fee via the HR MoMo portal link: gnpc-hr-onboarding.com before 5 PM today.

choices.text: Pay the GHS 450 fee quickly to secure this high-paying job
Ignore the email. Real companies do not charge processing fees.

lesson.technique: Fake corporate job offer with advance fee request
warningSigns: Legitimate organizations in Ghana (especially state agencies like GNPC) will never ask you to pay for background checks or IDs via MoMo
Offers for high-paying jobs without a formal interview process are always scams
The urgency ('before 5 PM today') is designed to prevent you from verifying the offer

conversation.text: Dear Merchant, your monthly MoMo transaction statement for the previous month has been generated.
To ensure data privacy, your statement is securely hosted on our web portal.
Click here: mtn-momo-statement-portal.web.app and enter your phone number and 4-digit MoMo PIN to download the document.

choices.text: Click the link and enter your MoMo PIN to view the statement
Delete the email. You should never enter your MoMo PIN on a website.

lesson.technique: Routine business email used to harvest MoMo PINs
warningSigns: Telecommunication companies will NEVER ask you to type your Mobile Money PIN into a website link
The domain uses '.web.app', which is a free hosting service, not an official MTN corporate domain
Real statements are either sent directly as password-protected PDFs or accessed via the official USSD/App

conversation.text: Hello boss, yes the iPhone 13 Pro Max is on a flash sale for GHS 4,500. It's slightly used, UK used.
That's a very good price. Can I do pay on delivery? I am at Madina.
Sorry boss, we stopped pay on delivery because dispatch riders were being robbed, and some customers waste our time.
This is the last piece left in the shop. Send the money to our merchant line 054XXXXXXX (Name: Kwame Osei) so I can give it to the rider right now.

choices.text: Send the GHS 4,500 to secure the phone before it sells out
Insist on visiting their physical shop or cancel the purchase

warningSigns: The price is too good to be true for an iPhone 13 Pro Max in Ghana
Vendor refuses pay-on-delivery and uses a personal MoMo name (Kwame Osei) instead of a registered business name
Creating artificial urgency ('last piece left') to rush your decision

conversation.text: Hello, is this Kwame's relative? I am CID Mensah calling from the Tesano Police Station.

Jesus! Can I speak to him?
We have locked him in the cells. We are processing him for court tomorrow morning. But if you can send GHS 1,500 via MoMo right now, I will drop the charges and release him to you secretly.

choices.text: Send the GHS 1,500 immediately to save your brother from going to jail
Hang up and call your brother's phone directly to verify his location

warningSigns: Police officers do not call relatives demanding MoMo payments to secretly drop criminal charges

They isolate you by refusing to let you speak to the supposed arrested relative

conversation.text: Good news! The connection at the embassy just texted me. Your Canada work visa is 90% approved.
They bypassed the VFS biometric queue for you. We just need to submit your medical report to Akai House Clinic.
The doctor says he will generate a clear report without you even coming in, but his protocol fee is GHS 2,000.
Send it to me right now so I can sort him out. If we miss this window, the embassy will reject the application.

choices.text: Send the GHS 2,000 to finalize your Canada visa process
Refuse the offer. Medicals for visas must be done in person at approved clinics.

warningSigns: It is strictly impossible to bypass VFS biometric queues or get a legitimate immigration medical report without being physically present
Scammers use the term 'protocol' to make illegal bribes seem like a standard, acceptable practice in Ghana
Pressure tactics ('miss this window') force you to pay without thinking

conversation.text: Welcome to the VIP Crypto Trading group. We trade directly with the global market to bring you massive profits.

choices.text: Message the admin and invest GHS 500 to get GHS 5,000
Report the group and leave. Bank of Ghana does not endorse 1000% returns in 45 minutes.

warningSigns: Guaranteed returns of 1000% in minutes are mathematically and economically impossible
Scammers use fake MoMo screenshots ('social proof') to make the scam look legitimate
Claiming false affiliation with regulators (Bank of Ghana, SEC) to build false trust
